exposure: Presence or absence of autoantibodies in patients with SCH
cohort: Patients with singleton pregnancies at ≤14 weeks gestation
finding: The occurrence of SCH may be related to maternal immune abnormalities and may increase the risk of premature rupture of membranes and abortion, but there is no correlation between the presence or absence of SCH and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Subchorionic hemorrhage (SCH) in the first trimester was associated with higher rates of premature rupture of membranes and miscarriage.
